implementation_notes: Created tests/test_phase2_stubs_retired.py as the queue-build-side companion to TASK-J004-020's dispatch-side retire test. The module mirrors the established Path.rglob + substring-check pattern from test_no_retired_roster_strings.py (TASK-J004-020), but is dedicated to the FEAT-J005 anchors so the failure surface and AC mapping stay clear. Four AC classes: TestAC001 walks src/jarvis/ and asserts LOG_PREFIX_QUEUE_BUILD is absent; TestAC002 narrows the substring 'queue_build stub' check to src/jarvis/tools/dispatch.py; TestAC003 pins the walk under 100ms with time.perf_counter; TestAC004 verifies the file:line diagnostic shape against a synthetic offender tree using monkeypatch + tmp_path so the helper proves AC-004 without relying on a real reintroduction. To make the assertions pass cleanly, src/jarvis/tools/dispatch.py needed a docstring/comment cleanup: three lingering references to the literal 'LOG_PREFIX_QUEUE_BUILD' in the module docstring and the Phase-2-anchor-retirement comment block were rewritten in descriptive form ('the queue-build log-prefix constant') so the literal symbol is fully gone from src/jarvis/. The forbidden-token literals are kept ONLY in the test module's globals so the source tree itself stays free of them — same convention used by the FEAT-J004 retire test.
